Governor Kay Ivey Honors Alabama’s 400,000 Heroes in Veterans Day Message

November 10, 2026

Videos

Share

Governor Ivey released a video message thanking the more than 400,000 veterans and their families who call Alabama home and honoring the generations of Americans who have served in the United States Armed Forces. (Governor’s Office, Gina Maiola & Alyssa Turner)
